name: Red Pepper Hummus & Veggie Pita Bento Box with Cheese, Raspberries & "Ants on a Log"

instructions.primary_message: This recipe utilizes a 4-compartment bento box. Please adjust the recipe as needed to accommodate the size of your bento box or food storage containers.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 stick celery
⅓ cup raspberries
¼ English cucumber
¼ cup baby spinach

instructions.primary_message: Trim celery, then cut crosswise into 2 1/2-inch long sticks. Fill with peanut butter, then stick raisin "ants" onto the "logs." Place in the medium compartment of the bento box.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp natural peanut butter
2 tsp raisins

instructions.primary_message: Place raspberries and cheese in the small compartments of the bento box.
Trim and slice cucumber crosswise into thin rounds. Season with salt and pepper.
Cut pita in half and carefully open the pockets. Spread each pocket with hummus, then fill with cucumber slices and spinach. Place pockets in the large compartment of the bento box.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 white pita bread
½ cup roasted red pepper hummus

instructions.primary_message: Cover bento box and refrigerate until ready to eat. Enjoy!
